Subject (in full) Communist Meeting held at 13 Doong Foong La (13号东), Tan
Tu Jao (打浦桥), Route de Zikawei, French Concession.

Made by D. I. Ross Forwarded by [Signature]

Secret Agent Ma Lien-wei (馬建文), Western District,
reports that some 30 members of the French Concession "District
Committee" of the local Chinese Communist Party held a meeting
at the above address between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. July 5 and
discussed the following matters :-
1. The victories of the Red Army in Hunan, Hupeh and Kiangsi.
2. The intensification of anti-imperialist activities by
factory representatives and the opposition to the
arrest of workmen by the Kuomintang.
3. The opposition of White Terrorism, the oppression of
capitalists and the dismissal of workers.
4. The establishment of branch offices of the Mutual Aid
Society to oppose White Terrorism.
5. The formation of Subscription Groups: each worker to
contribute one or two copper cents to provide comforts
for the Red Army and relatives of comrades who have been
arrested.
6. The declaration of a strike and presentation of demands
for the purpose of helping the Red Army and celebrating
its victories.
7. The opposition to the arrest by imperialists of Shiang
Tsoong-fah, leader of the Chinese Communist Party.
8. The staging of street demonstrations by workmen to
commemorate the execution of Shiang Tsoong-fah.
9. The staging of a big demonstration on August 1
(International Red Day)
The meeting was presided over by Kiang Dah-fu (江達夫),
member of the French Concession District Committee.
It is reported that another meeting will be held

事由（全称） 法租界徐家汇路打浦桥东丰里13号举行的共产党会议。

由 D. I. Ross 制作 经由 [签名] 转呈

西区密探马建文（Ma Lien-wei）报告称，当地中国共产党法租界“区委”约30名成员于7月5日上午7时至下午7时在上述地址举行会议，讨论了以下事项：
1. 红军在湖南、湖北和江西的胜利。
2. 工厂代表加强反帝活动，并反对国民党逮捕工人。
3. 反对白色恐怖、资本家的压迫以及解雇工人。
4. 建立互助社分支机构以反对白色恐怖。
5. 成立募捐小组：每名工人捐献一两个铜板，用于慰问红军及被捕同志的家属。
6. 为援助红军并庆祝其胜利而宣布罢工并提出要求。
7. 反对帝国主义者逮捕中国共产党领导人向忠发（Shiang Tsoong-fah）。
8. 工人举行街头示威，纪念向忠发（Shiang Tsoong-fah）被处决。
9. 在8月1日（国际红色日）举行大规模示威。
会议由法租界区委委员江达夫（Kiang Dah-fu）主持。
据报，另一次会议将于
